text: Need a straight answer please. Daughter is 8, temp 38.2 this evening. She was sick once around teatime but she's kept drinks down since then, water and a bit of squash, no problem. Neck seems fine, I got her to look down at her toes and she did it easily. The reason I'm messaging is that while I was getting her into pyjamas I spotted some small purple-ish marks on her lower legs and a few on her side. A couple look more like little bruises, but she hasn't knocked herself as far as I know. I did the glass thing and pressed it on them, and I think they're still there through it, they don't seem to go paler. I might be pressing wrong, the light's not great in her room. I don't want to drag her out at night if it's nothing, but I don't want to sit on it either. What should I be doing?
